name: scroll-map
title: Scroll Map
description: A map beside the text that draws a route as you scroll: the line is drawn, a dot rides its end and the camera follows it, zooming in and back out; a button opens the map to full width.
label: Scroll map
author: Tom Miller <https://codepen.io/creativeocean>
attribution: Copyright (c) 2026 by Tom Miller (https://codepen.io/creativeocean/pen/myOVZYO). MIT License.

props.name: children
props.description: The text beside the map. Headings, paragraphs, lists and a div with the class shaded are styled like the pen's.

props.name: route
props.description: The route, as an SVG path (d) in the map's 1500 x 1500 space. Any path works; it is measured with getTotalLength.

props.name: art
props.description: What lies under the route, in the same space: SVG content such as your own <image> of a map. The default is generated, not a photograph.

props.name: size
props.description: The side of the map's square viewBox.

props.name: zoom
props.description: The scale at the start and at its deepest, half way along the route.

props.name: scrub
props.description: Seconds the drawing takes to catch up with the scroll (an expo-out glide, restarted on every change); 0 follows the scroll directly.

props.name: split
props.description: The closed width of the map, in percent of the component's box.

props.name: container
props.description: The scrolling element the map follows, for a map inside a scroll container (give it position: relative and container-type: size). The window by default.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the map.

props.name: description
props.description: What the map shows, read after its name.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: The text of the button that opens the map (shown in capitals).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the close button.

props.name: expandIcon
props.description: Replaces the glyph before the expand text.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controls whether the map is open.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the map starts open, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when the map opens or closes.

a11y: The map is an image named by label and described by description (an SVG title and desc); the route, dot and street art inside it are not announced separately.

The expand button is a native button with aria-expanded: Enter and Space open the map. Opening moves focus to the close button and makes the text beside the map inert; Escape or the close button closes it and returns focus to the expand button.
Reduced motion: nothing is tied to the scroll position. The whole route is drawn at once with the dot at its end, and the map opens and closes without a tween.
Right to left: the map takes the inline start side and the text the other; the map picture itself is not mirrored.
Colours are --scroll-map-* variables with light and dark values; under forced colors the callout gets an outline.
